# Contribution Guidelines

When contributing to the project please add an entry to the Current Contributors section. This helps me keep track of who has contributed to the project before.

Our syntax is defined in the [**.editorconfig**](../.editorconfig) file located at the project's root.

Please also follow the file organization found in [ORGANIZATION.md](ORGANIZATION.md)

## Member naming

Private fields should be named `_likeThis` (prefixed with an underscore, camel case) and constants should be named `LIKE_THIS`.

# Current Contributors
## Template
Fields in curly braces are to be replaced with your own text.

```
{Your Git username} ([{Your Github account username}](https:///github.com/{Your github account username}))
```
